card.name: Words just before "care" or "caution"
card.fires_on: The word right before "care" or "caution" in phrases like "taking care", "with caution" and "exercise caution". It fires on "taking", "with" and "exercise" in instructions.

modes.label: Taking care
modes.description: The word "taking" in handling or application steps, just before "care to" avoid something.
modes.example: rub in gently and completely,<< taking>> care to prevent the solution spreading onto the

modes.label: With caution
modes.description: The word "with" after "administered" or "used", just before "caution" in warnings.
modes.example: Nadolol should be administered<< with>> caution since it may block bronchodilation

modes.label: Exercise caution
modes.description: The verb "exercise" (or its first part) just before "caution".
modes.example: Patients should be advised to<< exercise>> caution in night driving and other hazardous occupations

card.writes: It pushes the model to output "care" or "caution" as the next word.
card.plain: It spots the point in a sentence where the next word will be "care" or "caution", as in "take care" or "use with caution".
